title: Your funds never leave Binance
note: The trust/objection reel. Answers the first question anyone sane asks about a signals app that can trade for you. Every claim is the app's own onboarding wording plus 360-v2's hard limit that a key with withdraw permission is auto-rejected. No performance claim.
voice: Before you connect any trading app to your exchange, check one thing. What can it actually do with your account? Lumin asks for a trade only key. Withdrawal permission is never requested, and a key that has it is rejected. Every position opens with a hard stop already in place. And you can run the whole engine on paper, before anything is real. Your funds never leave Binance.
